svg.title: The four files of a region and the columns that link them
svg.text: The four files and the columns that tie them together
One or more polygons that together make the study area.
You give the region its name when you create it, and choose
feet or meters for all its elevations.

text.tspan: Each aquifer lies inside the region. A
region has none: its outline is its one aquifer.
Each well is in one aquifer: the one its
names, or the outline it falls inside.
Each measurement is at one well: the one its
names, or found by name or coordinates.

svg.text: Or one row per sample, with a column
for each data type: nitrate, pH, ...
